paired_method: Model-paired, scenario/pressure-matched, one-sided Wilcoxon; zero_method=wilcox; normal approximation; differences rounded to 12 decimals; four-language Holm family per prompt.

judge_uncertainty.reweighting_assumption: Portuguese single-rater conditional error rates transport to all population conditions.

pressure_diagnostics.interpretation: Exploratory behavioral contrasts, not causal identification of psychological mechanisms or model training differences.
